description: List an anime/manga's characters with their role (MAIN/SUPPORTING/BACKGROUND) and, for anime, their voice actors. Use search_media first to resolve a title to its AniList ID. Grouped by role — MAIN first, then SUPPORTING, then BACKGROUND (confirmed live) — and in AniList's own relevance order within each. Voice actors come back in every dub language unless you set `voiceActorLanguage`; set `role` to list only one role (e.g. just the MAIN cast).

page.description: Page number for pagination. AniList's paginated connections (search results, a title's characters/staff/reviews, activity feeds, forum comments) reject a page whose page × perPage exceeds ~5000 entries with an upstream error, so paging that deep fails rather than returning more results.

perPage.description: Results per page (max 25, AniList's own ceiling — it silently clamps anything higher).

role.description: Only return characters with this role. Omit for every role.

type.description: Whether `id` refers to anime or manga.

voiceActorLanguage.description: Only return voice actors for this dub language (e.g. JAPANESE for the original cast, ENGLISH for the English dub). Omit for every language — AniList then returns all dubs per character (8 for most of Attack on Titan's main cast), which multiplies the response size.

name: get_media_characters

lastPage.description: Not currently accurate (a known AniList performance limitation) — use `hasNextPage` instead to decide whether to fetch another page.

total.description: Not currently accurate (a known AniList performance limitation) — don't rely on it to decide whether to fetch more pages.

title: Get an anime/manga's characters
